messages:
Rafa: noticed p99 jump on endpoints panel for /v1/stream at ~02:15 UTC. p50/p95 steady. anyone else?
June: which filters? region=us-west? model?
Rafa: Console -> Latency -> Endpoints; region=us-west, model=redwood-7b, endpoint=/v1/stream. Link: https://console/redwood/latency?endpoint=%2Fv1%2Fstream
Ibrahim: quick backend note: we merge t-digests from shards and compute percentiles, so math is fine. problem is presentation: sample_origin is hidden and users see a single p99 number.
Tess: infra logs show quota_fallback events at 02:14 for tenant=shop-now -> fallback to pool:legacy-fast. snippet: ```{"ts":"2026-03-22T02:14:12Z","tenant":"shop-now","decision":"fallback","target":"pool:legacy-fast","reason":"quota_exceeded"}```
June: UX fix proposal: show total_sample_count next to pctl and a tiny origin-badge listing top origin + percent. also add a drilldown link that partitions percentiles by sample_origin.
Ibrahim: agree. also add low-sample warning when total_sample_count < 50. sampling fractions vary across proxies so counts matter.
Tess: I'll open a small PR for the badge + drilldown + low-sample hint. ETA today.
diag-bot: routing-service v4.0 deployed at 2026-03-22T01:58:00Z (sha: a1b2c3d) :rocket:
Rafa: thanks all. plan: land PR, verify p99 drops after routing weight tweak, and notify CS if customers ask.
June: will also add a Console blurb explaining merged t-digest semantics and recommended debug flow.
